includeStale.description: Include stale entries in the response. Default false. Stale entries are pending requests the caller can no longer act on - on the principal side this means the user has lost eligibility for the target; on the approver side it means no live stage/step is assigned to the caller. Set to true to see and (for principal-side requests) cancel them via the matching pim_*_request_cancel tool.

pageSize.description: Maximum items per page sent to the upstream API (1-999, default 100). Larger values reduce round-trips on big tenants.

maxPages.description: Maximum number of pages to fetch before reporting the result truncated (1-100, default 10). When truncated, re-run with a higher value or a narrower filter.
